content:
maria-peopleops: Quick heads up — converting devon-eng from contractor -> full time with an official start date 2026-04-05. Need confirmation on when 401(k) auto-enroll and HSA pretax deductions kick in given payroll cutoffs. Who can confirm timelines?

devon-eng: thanks! two things — will 401k auto-enroll apply to my first FT paycheck or the following one? also any chance of doing retroactive contributions for the contractor pay period? :thinking:

john-payroll: usually deductions start on the first payroll that processes after we change employment status and the benefits enrollment is submitted. key is the payroll cutoff. our cutoff for the 4/10 payday was 2026-04-01. if the conversion posts before cutoff, deductions can start 4/10; otherwise 4/24. i'll verify vendor enrollment lead times. :mag:

maria-peopleops: devon will be added to payroll on 4/05 (HR toggle done). devon — are you able to complete the online benefits enrollment within the standard 30-day window? we need that to trigger the 401k elections.

devon-eng: yes i'll complete enrollment today. curious about employer match timing too — is match pro-rated for mid-pay period starts?

sasha-hr: quick policy note: Redwood auto-enrolls new FT employees at 5% pre-tax by default (employees can opt/change during enrollment). company match is 50% of first 6% (so up to 3% employer contribution). match is applied from the first eligible paycheck after enrollment — we do not typically backdate employee pre-tax payroll deductions to contractor payments.

john-payroll: confirming sasha is right. contractor (1099) payments cannot be reclassified into 401k deductions retroactively. payroll/legal prevents moving prior contractor wages into deferrals. employer match could be handled as a discretionary contribution in exceptional cases, but that's a separate journal and needs approval from finance.

maria-peopleops: HSA Q too — devon, do you elect HSA through the plan (SunHealth HSA-Plus)? employer contribution is prorated for the calendar year based on eligible months enrolled. If you enroll within 30 days of conversion, you'll get a prorated employer deposit on the next monthly HSA funding cycle.

devon-eng: yes i'll pick SunHealth HSA-Plus. if the enrollment completes before payroll cutoff, will the HSA pretax payroll deduction start immediately?

john-payroll: HSA pretax deductions require the HSA deduction code to be active before payroll runs. So same cutoff rules apply: before cutoff -> starts 4/10; after -> 4/24. Employer deposit (the company's contribution) will be prorated and typically funded on the next vendor funding date (we pay HSA deposits on the 15th of the month following the first eligible payday).

payroll-bot: Reminder: payroll cutoff calendar 
``
- 2026-04-01: cutoff for 2026-04-10 payroll
- 2026-04-15: HSA vendor funding window
``

payroll-bot: If you need an exception (e.g., expedite enrollment), please file a ticket to payroll and cc people-ops.

maria-peopleops: action items: 1) devon to complete benefits enrollment now; 2) i'll confirm cutoff inclusion with payroll ops and reply here; 3) devon to confirm whether they want to change default auto-enroll %.

devon-eng: completed enrollment and selected 6% deferral (opting higher than default). thanks — please confirm final paycheck dates so i know when deductions start. :pray:

john-payroll: got the enrollment update. i checked — HR toggled employment status in time so you're in the 4/10 run. your 401k deductions and HSA pretax will start on the 4/10 paycheck. employer match will begin calculating on that payroll and the prorated employer HSA deposit goes out on 2026-04-15. :thumbsup:

maria-peopleops: great, closing loop. devon — if you want any changes to deferral % or Roth vs pre-tax we can update within 30 days of your FT start. welcome aboard! :tada:
